service.description: SUPP's time finds its rates again (mantle.work.TimeServices.resetAndGet#ProjectTimeEntryRates: the time was logged before the rates were loaded), then a draft client invoice to Brightwater Dental Group of the approved time (Joe Developer's week two weeks back), by the real path (mantle.account.InvoiceServices.create#ProjectInvoiceItems with approvedOnly and billableOnly, a line per worker as the organization's billing defaults say, Net 30). Each part on its own: one that fails is logged and the rest go on. Loading again adds nothing when SUPP has an invoice already.
